title: Sleep deprivation
content: Has anyone tried to stay up for days and remembered their dreams on the first night back to sleep? Imagine missing a few nights of sleep was like missing years in the dream world that you were missing an action. The past few months I've been having intense reoccurring dreams where I'm living a whole nother life. I've never had so much eye crust in my entire life waking up or had the feeling of doing so many things and interacting with people. Thing is it almost feels like I'm running or trying escape whereever I am.
